design_reference: Editeur Livre-Jeu - Wireframes.dc.html § 04 → 4A « ÉCRAN — PNJ »: identity (NOM + DIALOGUE, portrait deferred), « SOURCE DU PNJ » (créer / choisir dans le livre — reusable, deferred to a catalog), and « Le PNJ donne un objet » reusing the shared object editor (NOM — interne / DESCRIPTION — lue par le joueur). Mounted via node-editor's « Action requise » seam. Low-fi wireframe, light theme.

plan.goal: Let an author configure a node's « PNJ » action — the character's name + dialogue, and optionally an object the PNJ gives — mounted into node-editor through the ActionRegistry, reusing the shared ObjectEditor without coupling features.
acceptance_criteria: action-pnj self-registers a « PNJ » editor with the brain ActionRegistry; node-editor's « Action requise » control offers « PNJ » alongside « Décor » with zero node-editor changes (Open/Closed, KR-051).
Selecting « PNJ » mounts the PNJ editor for that node; structural screens (sommaire/mort) never show it.
The editor captures the PNJ name + a player-facing dialogue, persisted on the node via BookService (single source of truth).

A « Le PNJ donne un objet » switch reveals the shared brain ObjectEditor (the same primitive action-decor uses, KR-052/109) capturing the gift's internal NAME + player-facing DESCRIPTION; turning it off removes the gift.
The gift object carries a stable id minted once and preserved across edits (KR-003).

All PNJ config is persisted through BookService.updateNode (no private copy, KR-020) and lives on the node document; action-pnj and node-editor never import each other (wired at the composition root).
The editor renders strictly from design-system primitives/tokens (Field, Toggle, ObjectEditor), light theme; controls are keyboard-operable with ≥44px targets.
plan.walking_skeleton: registerActionPnj registers an ActionEditor { type:'pnj', label:'PNJ', render } with the brain ActionRegistry (wired at the App composition root, alongside action-decor). PnjEditor reads node.pnj live via useOpenBook and writes via BookService.updateNode: a NAME Field, a DIALOGUE Field, and a « donne un objet » Toggle that reveals the shared brain ObjectEditor for the gift (stable id). Reusable PNJ catalog + portrait + dialogue tree are later iterations.

iterations.goal: Gift effect (§ 4A): object effect (+N PV / +N Attaque / +N Défense / objet de scénario) + value stepper; « ensuite le PNJ mène à » target wiring.
Portrait upload + the dialogue affordance; richer identity.
Reusable PNJs via a shared catalog (« créer / choisir dans le livre »), referenced by stable id — paired with the ObjectCatalogService work (KR-062).

known_risks: KR-050/051 — node-editor is a host: action-pnj self-registers via the ActionRegistry and is mounted without being imported; adding the action needs zero node-editor changes.

KR-052 — the gift object carries a player-facing DESCRIPTION, not just a name; captured via the SHARED brain ObjectEditor (now its second consumer), never a bare string and never a per-feature copy (KR-109).
KR-020 — PNJ config is read/written through BookService (the SSOT); the editor holds no private copy and reflects live via useOpenBook.
KR-003 — the gift object is referenced by a stable id minted once (createId) and preserved across edits.
KR-090 — PNJ config lives on the node document (node.pnj); structural screens never carry it (updateNode's text-only guard for sommaire/mort, KR-055).
KR-013 — derive the editor's current values inline from the live node, not via a useEffect-synced mirror.

iterations_log.label: walking-skeleton
architecture_choices: Second action-* feature: self-registers with the brain ActionRegistry at the App composition root (registerActionPnj) — proves the seam scales (two registered editors, « Décor » + « PNJ ») with zero node-editor changes (KR-050/051).

Reuses the shared brain ObjectEditor for « donne un objet » (KR-052/109): the gift edits go through the same primitive as action-decor's « prendre », imported from brain — no cross-feature import. This validates the ObjectEditor was correctly placed in brain at its first use.

PnjEditor is a VIEW over BookService (KR-020): reads node.pnj via useOpenBook, normalises it once (DEFAULT_PNJ + destructure, mirroring the cleaned DecorEditor), writes via updateNode; the gift's stable id is minted lazily and preserved (KR-003).

Domain model gained node.pnj (PnjConfig); NodePatch carries pnj so updateNode's text-only guard keeps it off structural screens (KR-055/090). Toggling the gift off persists pnj without a gift (JSON drops the undefined).
deviations_from_plan: Gift effect/value, the « mène à » target, portrait, and the reusable-PNJ catalog are deferred to iterations 1–3; the skeleton ships name + dialogue + a single optional gift object.

test_coverage.integration: action-pnj via App — « PNJ » offered through the registry seam, name persisted, the gift reveals the SHARED ObjectEditor and persists with a stable id, removing the gift drops it; structural-screen guard now covers pnj (BookService)

open_questions: Gift effects + « mène à » target (iteration 1), portrait/dialogue affordance (iteration 2).
Reusable PNJ + object catalogs (iteration 3) — share with the ObjectCatalogService work needed for hidden-prereqs (KR-062).
